records.jp: この場合の動きはこんなイメージで……。^00あら、日菜子じゃない。^00どうかしたの？
records.en_original: In this case, you'll want to move like this... Oh, it's you, Hinako. What's going on?
records.en_auxiliary: In this case, you'll want to move like this... Oh, it's you, Hinako. What's going on?
records.en: In this case, you'll want to move like this... Oh, it's you, Hinako. What's going on?

records.jp: ねぇ、膝の調子はどう？^00いつの間にか治ってて、またバレエを……。^00……っ、ごめんなさい
records.en_original: Hey, how's your knee doing? Wait, has it recovered? Can you do ballet ag-- ...Oh, I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, how's your knee doing? Wait, has it recovered? Can you do ballet ag—Er... I'm sorry.
records.en: Hey, how's your knee doing? Wait, has it recovered? Can you do ballet ag-- ...Oh, I'm sorry.

records.jp: あの原種ってのを倒していけば、^00またバレエができるようになるのよね。^00……私も協力するから、頑張りなさい
records.en_original: If we defeat those Sephira things, you'll be able to dance again, right? ...Then I'll help you. We can do this.
records.en_auxiliary: If we defeat those Sephira things, you'll be able to dance again, right? Then I'll help you. We can do this.
records.en: If we defeat those Sephira things, you'll be able to dance again, right? ...Then I'll help you. We can do this.

records.jp: ……私はあなたのこと待ってるから。^00また同じ舞台に立つ日まで、ね
records.en_original: ...I'll be waiting for the day we stand on the same stage again. No matter how long it takes. Okay?
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be waiting for the day we stand on the same stage again, no matter how long it takes. Okay?
records.en: ...I'll be waiting for the day we stand on the same stage again. No matter how long it takes. Okay?

records.jp: 決断をするのはあなたしかいない。^00悔いのないよう、じっくり考えなさい
records.en_original: Only you can make the decision. Think about it carefully, so you won't have any regrets.
records.en_auxiliary: Only you can make the decision. Think about it carefully, so you won't have any regrets.
records.en: Only you can make the decision. Think about it carefully, so you won't have any regrets.

records.jp: たとえ記憶がなくなっても、^00私たちはまた仲良くなれる。^00……私はそう、信じてるわ
records.en_original: Even if I lose my memory, we'll become friends again. ...I'm sure of it.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if I lose my memory, we'll become friends again. I'm sure of it.
records.en: Even if I lose my memory, we'll become friends again. ...I'm sure of it.

records.jp: 一応言っておくわ。^00私はあなたのこと、嫌いだから
records.en_original: Just so you know, I don't like you.
records.en_auxiliary: Just so you know, I don't like you.
records.en: Just so you know, I don't like you.

records.jp: あーら、普通科の人が何の用？^00ここは特・待・科！　^00トクベツな人しか入れない場所なのよ？
records.en_original: Oh? What's someone from the regular class doing here? This is the SPECIAL class. For special people only. Got it?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh? What's someone from the regular class doing here? This is the SPECIAL class. For special people only. Got it?
records.en: Oh? What's someone from the regular class doing here? This is the SPECIAL class. For special people only. Got it?

records.jp: ふふ、特待科は特別なのよ！^00気持ち普通科より豪華な椅子に、^00そこはかとなく綺麗な黒板に……
records.en_original: Haha, the special class is a cut above the regular one! Somewhat fancier chairs, slightly cleaner blackboards...
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, the special class is a cut above the regular one! Somewhat fancier chairs, slightly cleaner blackboards...
records.en: Haha, the special class is a cut above the regular one! Somewhat fancier chairs, slightly cleaner blackboards...

records.jp: とにかく、普通科とは！^00普通科とは違うのよ！
records.en_original: Anyway, we're different! SO much different from the regular class!
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, we're different! SO much different from the regular class!
records.en: Anyway, we're different! SO much different from the regular class!

records.jp: 普通科の子にテストで負けた……！^00嘘よ、そんなのあり得ない。^00だって、私は特待科なのに……！
records.en_original: I did worse on my test than a regular class girl...! They must be joking! I'm in the special class, after all!
records.en_auxiliary: I did worse on my test than a regular class girl! They must be joking! I'm in the special class, after all!
records.en: I did worse on my test than a regular class girl...! They must be joking! I'm in the special class, after all!

records.jp: よく来たわね、ゆっくりしていきなさい。^00……特待科も普通科も関係ない。^00みんな、同じ学校の仲間なんだから
records.en_original: Welcome. Stay as long as you'd like. It doesn't matter what class you're in. We're all Hoshinomiya students here.
records.en_auxiliary: Welcome. Stay as long as you'd like. It doesn't matter what class you're in. We're all Hoshinomiya students here.
records.en: Welcome. Stay as long as you'd like. It doesn't matter what class you're in. We're all Hoshinomiya students here.

records.jp: んしょ……っと。^00黒板消しに日誌に号令に。^00日直って地味に面倒よねぇ……
records.en_original: Urgh... Clean the blackboard, fill out the log, lead the greetings... Being class secretary is such a pain...
records.en_auxiliary: Urgh... Clean the blackboard, fill out the log, lead the greetings... Being class secretary is such a pain.
records.en: Urgh... Clean the blackboard, fill out the log, lead the greetings... Being class secretary is such a pain...

records.jp: 特待科って校外活動する人が多いから、^00よく日直がまわってくるのよねぇ……。^00うー、めんどくさい……
records.en_original: Special class students are always missing school! How's a class secretary supposed to note attendance? Ugh...
records.en_auxiliary: Special class students are always missing school! How's a class secretary supposed to note attendance? Ugh...
records.en: Special class students are always missing school! How's a class secretary supposed to note attendance? Ugh...

records.jp: もういや！　どれだけ日直やればいいの！？^00なんなの？　私の青春は日直で終わるの！？
records.en_original: I can't take it anymore! Do I have to be class secretary EVERY SINGLE DAY? Is this how my teenage years rot away!?
records.en_auxiliary: I can't take it anymore! Do I have to be class secretary EVERY SINGLE DAY? Is this how my teenage years rot away?!
records.en: I can't take it anymore! Do I have to be class secretary EVERY SINGLE DAY? Is this how my teenage years rot away!?

records.jp: 私、吹っ切れたわ。^00特待科の中で一番の日直上手になってやる！^00目指すは全国一の日直ニストよ！
records.en_original: You know what?! FINE. I'm going to be the best damn secretary in the special class! The best one in the country!
records.en_auxiliary: You know what?! FINE. I'm going to be the best damn secretary in the special class! The best one in the country!
records.en: You know what?! FINE. I'm going to be the best damn secretary in the special class! The best one in the country!

records.jp: 周りは全員、できる子ばかり。^00負けられない、あたしだって……！
records.en_original: Everyone around me is super talented. I've got to work hard to keep up!
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone around me is super talented. I've got to work hard to keep up!
records.en: Everyone around me is super talented. I've got to work hard to keep up!

records.jp: 森川更紗……。^00バレエが少しうまいくらいでなによ……。^00あたしだって体の柔らかさには自信あるし
records.en_original: Sarasa Morikawa... "Oh, look at me, I'm good at ballet"... I'm flexible too, you know.
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa Morikawa... "Oh, look at me, I'm good at ballet"... I'm flexible too, you know.
records.en: Morikawa Sarasa... "Oh, look at me, I'm good at ballet"... I'm flexible too, you know.

records.jp: 多谷史緒……。^00ピアノが上手だからってなんなのよ。^00体力勝負なら絶対に負けない自信があるわ
records.en_original: Fumio Taya... So what if she's a piano prodigy! I bet I'm in better shape than she is.
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio Taya... So what if she's a piano prodigy?! I bet I'm in better shape than she is.
records.en: Taya Fumio... So what if she's a piano prodigy! I bet I'm in better shape than she is.

records.jp: 麻央様はいつ見ても美人よね。^00特待科の中でも一際輝いて見えるわ。^00あたしもあんな風になれたらいいのに……
records.en_original: Miss Mao's so gorgeous. She outshines everyone, even in the special class. I wish I could be like her...
records.en_auxiliary: Mao's so gorgeous. She outshines everyone, even in the special class. I wish I could be like her.
records.en: Mao-sama's so gorgeous. She outshines everyone, even in the special class. I wish I could be like her...

records.jp: 特待科……。^00自分の進む道に向かって輝く姿と、^00周りに負けじと弾けるプライド……！
records.en_original: The special class... Full of shining stars who forge their own paths and big egos unwilling to be outdone...!
records.en_auxiliary: The special class... Full of shining stars who forge their own paths and big egos unwilling to be outdone!
records.en: The special class... Full of shining stars who forge their own paths and big egos unwilling to be outdone...!

records.jp: ああ、いい……。^00とってもいいわ……。^00うふふふふふ……
records.en_original: Ahh, good... Very good... Hahahahahaha......
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, good... Very good... Hahahahahaha...
records.en: Ahh, good... Very good... Hahahahahaha......

records.jp: みんな、とっても素敵。^00時を経るにつれ着実に成長してて……。^00ふふふ、いいわね、青春ね……！
records.en_original: Everyone's so incredible. Steadily growing as the days go by... Hehehe. Ah, youth! How wonderful it is!
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone's so incredible. Steadily growing as the days go by... Hehehe. Ah, youth! How wonderful it is!
records.en: Everyone's so incredible. Steadily growing as the days go by... Hehehe. Ah, youth! How wonderful it is!

records.jp: 最近、ちょっと不安になるのよね。^00周りのみんなと比べると、^00私はちゃんとできてないんじゃないかって
records.en_original: I've been worried lately that I'm not doing so well compared to everyone around me.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been worried lately that I'm not doing so well compared to everyone around me.
records.en: I've been worried lately that I'm not doing so well compared to everyone around me.

records.jp: ……なーんて。^00変なこと言ったわ。忘れてちょうだい
records.en_original: ...Just kidding. I'm talking nonsense. Forget I said anything.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Just kidding. I'm talking nonsense. Forget I said anything.
records.en: ...Just kidding. I'm talking nonsense. Forget I said anything.

records.jp: うふふ、私も負けないわよ……。^00私だってみんなと同じ……^00特待科の一員なんだもの
records.en_original: Heh heh heh... I won't let them beat me! I'm a member of the special class, same as they are!
records.en_auxiliary: Heh heh heh... I won't let them beat me! I'm a member of the special class, same as they are!
records.en: Heh heh heh... I won't let them beat me! I'm a member of the special class, same as they are!

records.jp: あれじゃ私がウザいって思われちゃうよね！^00し、失礼しましたー！
records.en_original: They'll think I'm annoying, won't they!? <CR>P-Please forgive me!
records.en_auxiliary: They'll think I'm annoying, won't they?!<CR>P-please forgive me!
records.en: They'll think I'm annoying, won't they!? <CR>P-Please forgive me!

records.jp: 卑怯なことはしないで、^00全力で勝負に臨むことにするよ
records.en_original: I won't pull any cowardly tricks. I'll meet the challenge head-on.
records.en_auxiliary: I won't pull any cowardly tricks. I'll meet the challenge head-on.
records.en: I won't pull any cowardly tricks. I'll meet the challenge head-on.

records.jp: 私もまだ私が目指す星には届いていない。あなたの願いをかなえる手助けはするけど、私も歩むペースを落とす気はないわ
records.en_original: I haven't reached my goal yet, either. I'll help you make your wish come true, but I'm not going to slow down.
records.en_auxiliary: I haven't reached my goal yet, either. I'll help you make your wish come true, but I'm not going to slow down.
records.en: I haven't reached my goal yet, either. I'll help you make your wish come true, but I'm not going to slow down.

records.jp: でも…、とりあえずこの間は…ありがとう
records.en_original: But... Thanks for helping me out.
records.en_auxiliary: But... Thanks for helping me out.
records.en: But... Thanks for helping me out.

records.jp: 今度の文化祭の出し物、あなたも何か考えといてね。学校に来てなかったあなたからの方が新鮮な意見がもらえるかもしれない
records.en_original: Be sure to bring some ideas to the festival meeting. You haven't been here long, so your perspective is fresh.
records.en_auxiliary: Be sure to bring some ideas to the festival meeting. You haven't been here long, so your perspective is fresh.
records.en: Be sure to bring some ideas to the festival meeting. You haven't been here long, so your perspective is fresh.

records.jp: 文化祭の出し物どうしようかなぁ…
records.en_original: What should we do for our culture festival program...?
records.en_auxiliary: What should we do for our culture festival program?
records.en: What should we do for our culture festival program...?

records.jp: 私ね、ネットオークションで絵を売るようになったの。自分で描いたやつね
records.en_original: Guess what? I've started selling art on internet auction sites. Pictures I drew!
records.en_auxiliary: Guess what? I've started selling art on internet auction sites. Pictures I drew!
records.en: Guess what? I've started selling art on internet auction sites. Pictures I drew!

records.jp: へぇ～っ、そんなことできちゃうんだ！^00……その、それって、……結構稼げたりする？
records.en_original: Whoa, I didn't know you could do that! ...So, are you...making a lot of money?
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, I didn't know you could do that! ...So, are you...making a lot of money?
records.en: Whoa, I didn't know you could do that! ...So, are you...making a lot of money?

records.jp: 特待科に入れてとっても幸せ。みんなそれぞれ自負する何かを持ってて、独特の道を歩んでるじゃない？
records.en_original: I'm so happy I got into the special class. Every student has her own forte, and is following her own path.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so happy I got into the special class. Every student has her own forte, and is following her own path.
records.en: I'm so happy I got into the special class. Every student has her own forte, and is following her own path.

records.jp: どんな子をモデルにしても、ドラマチックなストーリーが書けそう。アイデアが尽きないわぁ……
records.en_original: Any girl here could serve as a good model for a dramatic story. The possibilities are endless...
records.en_auxiliary: Any girl here could serve as a good model for a dramatic story. The possibilities are endless.
records.en: Any girl here could serve as a good model for a dramatic story. The possibilities are endless...
